text: Reopened - I closed this a minute ago and should not have. The candidate 4383a85 is posted with evidence but the merge gate is posted SHA + evidence + CHIEF ACK, and I supplied two of the three. Closing on my own say-so makes the gate advisory, and it is the same error as an author approving their own review. It stays at doing until the chief acks. Noting it here rather than quietly reverting because a bead that flickers closed and open with no explanation is worse than either state.
